conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones), skeleton only, 30 fps, frames start at 1
conventions.clip: 4.0 s: standing at the mark (0.2 s) -> 2.1 s accelerating run-up (jog, run, sprint; ~15 m) -> bound -> back-foot contact -> front-foot contact -> release at 2.93 s -> follow-through and deceleration
conventions.world: the bowler runs toward the rig's forward direction (-y); his popping crease at y=0, his stumps at y=+1.22, the batter's stumps at y=-18.9; start_position_m gives the mark
conventions.arms: ra_ = right-arm over the wicket, la_ = left-arm over the wicket (mirror)
conventions.ball: attach the ball to the bowling hand (RightHand / LeftHand) until release_frame and launch it from release_point_m
conventions.variations: these are stock deliveries; the bowling_motions set's release variants (bouncer, yorker, cutters, slower balls...) and its delivery map still apply - use the release physics from that map with these actions

clips.description: Classical side-on: back foot lands parallel to the crease, hips and shoulders side-on, front arm reaching high at the batter, bowling arm close to vertical
Front-on (chest-on): back foot points down the pitch, chest faces the batter at back-foot contact, shorter stride, arm a little wider of vertical
Slinger: mixed action with big shoulder counter-rotation, front arm swung out wide, low round-arm whip, release about 25 cm lower
